item.title: Who do you know in this Grantham school photo?
item.description: The old St Anne’s School closed its doors on its Dudley Road Victorian premises for a final time in July 1973. They moved to a new one on Harrowby Road. Unfortunately it wasn’t quite ready so some pupils were put up in St Anne’s Church until it was ready. Know anyone?
